sokkel-tui.note: parts/text-field's masked option: each character drawn as the bullet; no reveal, no sealed state, no Replace.

summary: A secret a form sets but never reads back, such as a connection's token or password. With nothing set it is a masked input with a Show button that reveals what is typed. With a secret already set (sealed) it says so, masked, with when it was set, and leaves it as it is unless Replace is pressed: Replace opens an empty input for the new secret, and Cancel or Escape seals it again, dropping what was typed. The value is the new secret, or none, so a form tells a secret left unchanged from a new one. The label, help and issue mark are parts/text-field's: a form never changes height (principle 12).

anatomy.field: parts/text-field's frame around the control: the label with its hint and required mark, the description, the help under it, and the issue mark with its popover.
anatomy.control: The frame: the input or the sealed line, then its buttons at the end, 4 apart; a press anywhere in an open frame but a button focuses the input.
anatomy.input: While open: the secret typed, each character masked by the browser until revealed; spell checking off, autoComplete new-password unless given, in the code face unless mono is false.
anatomy.reveal: While open and the field can be changed: a frame button with an eye, named and titled words.show, or with a crossed eye and words.hide while the secret shows; a toggle (aria-pressed).
anatomy.cancel: While a sealed field is open for a new secret and can be changed: parts/button's ghost at xs, words.cancel; it seals the field again.
anatomy.sealedMark: While sealed: a key in muted-foreground at the line's start.
anatomy.dots: While sealed: eight dots in the code face, widely tracked, in muted-foreground, never the secret, which is not read back.
anatomy.setNote: While sealed: words.set, or words.setWhen with setAt said relative to now (RelativeTime), in text.xs muted-foreground, cut short with an ellipsis.
anatomy.replace: While sealed and the field can be changed: parts/button's ghost at xs, words.replace, named words.replaceLabel with the field's label and described by the set note; the label points at it. A field that cannot be changed draws none.

value.does: The new secret typed, or none: with none, the secret set is left as it is, or, with nothing set, none is given. Never the secret already set.
value.sokkel-ui: value, onChange (an emptied input is none)

sealed.does: A secret is already set where the app keeps it: the field shows it as set until Replace.

setAt.does: When the secret was set, said relative to now after words.setWhen.

now.does: The moment setAt is counted from; the clock when not given.

defaultReplacing.does: A sealed field starts open for a new secret, as if Replace was pressed.

autoComplete.does: What the browser may fill in: new-password for a secret being set, current-password for one asked for again (a sign-in, a confirm).

mono.does: The secret in the code face, as keys and tokens are.

error.does: Why the value is refused, as one critical issue (parts/text-field's issues).

issues.does: The app's issues: parts/text-field's issue mark says the worst.

issueOpen.does: Whether the mark's popover is open, held from outside.

readOnly.does: Shows the field with no reveal, no Cancel and no Replace.

disabled.does: Cannot be used: faded, no buttons, the cursor not-allowed.

bare.does: The control alone, without the label and the issue mark, for a form that draws its own: the label names the input, and the issues given color its edge.

control.note: density.control: 32 regular, 28 compact; 10 at the start and 4 at the end. The text 16 below 768 and text.sm from it, so a phone does not zoom the page on focus.

reveal.note: parts/date-field's frame button: control-xs square (24, 20 compact).

sealedMark.note: The key, 14 square, 4 before the dots.

rest.means: Open with nothing typed (its placeholder), or holding a new secret, masked.

hover.means: The pointer is over a frame button, Replace or Cancel: washed hover, its icon or word in foreground. The control itself has no hover look.

focus.means: Focus anywhere in an open frame: the ring edge and a 1px ring, however the focus came. A sealed frame draws no ring of its own; Replace shows its keyboard focus.
focus.reached: Tab, or a press anywhere in the open frame
focus.sokkel-ui: focus-within:border-ring focus-within:ring-1 focus-within:ring-ring on the open frame

keyFocus.means: Keyboard focus on the reveal (a focus-ring-width ring in ring at half strength), or on Replace or Cancel (parts/button's focus outline).

disabled.means: Cannot be used: faded, no buttons, the cursor not-allowed.

readOnly.means: No reveal, no Cancel and no Replace; an open input is focusable and selectable. No look of its own.

invalid.means: The worst issue is critical (error or a critical issue): the critical edge at rest.

invalid+focus.means: An invalid field with focus in it keeps the critical edge at 80 and takes the frame's 1px ring in ring, not the invalid ring: the field puts the issue's edge on its first child, and the frame only puts the full edge and the invalid ring on itself when bare.
invalid+focus.reached: focus in an invalid open field
invalid+focus.sokkel-ui: Field's [&>:first-child]:border-critical/80 over the frame's focus-within:border-ring; ISSUE_WITHIN_EDGE only when bare

warning.means: The worst issue is a warning: the warning edge at rest.

warning+focus.means: A field with a warning and focus in it: the warning edge at 80 and the frame's 1px ring in ring, as invalid+focus.
warning+focus.reached: focus in an open field with a warning

sealed.means: A secret is set and not being replaced: the frame on muted at 40, the key, eight dots, the set note and Replace; no input.
sealed.reached: sealed, with no value and Replace not pressed (or Cancel or Escape after it)

replacing.means: A sealed field open for a new secret: the empty input, the reveal and Cancel; focus moves into the input.
replacing.reached: Replace, defaultReplacing, or a value given while sealed

shown.means: The secret typed shows as text, and the reveal says words.hide and is pressed; sealing the field again masks it.

rest.note: The page's ink: neither the frame nor its bare input sets one.

keyboard.does: Focuses the input, then the reveal, then Cancel when a sealed field is open, then the issue mark when there is one; a sealed field's stop is Replace.
Shows the secret typed, or masks it again.
Opens the field for a new secret and moves focus into the empty input.
Seals the field again: what was typed is dropped, the value is none, the secret is masked, and focus moves to Replace.
keyboard.when: the input of a sealed field that can be changed has focus

keyboard.does: Seals the field again, as Escape does.

appText.label: The field's label, hint, description and help, as parts/text-field takes them; the label also names Replace through words.replaceLabel.
appText.error: Why the app refuses the value.

cells.width: The width its column gives it; else 280 px by the rule (33 columns), as parts/text-field.
cells.density: Nothing changes: the label, the control and the help are one row each, as parts/text-field.

control.note: parts/text-field's control: edge-start and edge-end at its ends in the edge's flat color for its state; focus-ring-start and focus-ring-end beside it only where it has no focus edge of its own.

input.note: Each character typed is one mask glyph, one cell each, while hidden: the value is never on screen until revealed. A paste lands at the cursor; a terminal leaves out its control characters and newlines, as parts/text-field's one-line input does.

reveal.width: 1 column at the control's end, a gap of 1 before it: eye while hidden (words.show), eye-off while shown (words.hide). An icon alone: its word is said in the status line while it has focus, with Enter and Space after it (principle 23).

cancel.note: parts/button's ghost in cells: its word with padX 1, no edge; 1 column before it.

sealedMark.width: 1 column, key-round, a gap of 1 after it.

dots.width: 8 columns: eight mask glyphs, never the secret.

setNote.note: After the dots and a gap of 1, the rest of the row, cut short with the ellipsis glyph; words.set or words.setWhen.

replace.note: parts/button's ghost in cells at the row's end.

cells.note: rows counts the label and the control; a description and help add their own lines. The reveal is a stop of its own after the input, toggled by Enter or Space as on the web; Escape in a sealed field's input and Cancel seal it again.

sokkel-ui: The open input is a password input while hidden and a text input while shown; the browser draws the mask.
The set note is RelativeTime, which says the exact time on hover.
SchemaForm draws a property marked writeOnly with this field, sealed where useSchemaForm's sealed says a secret is set.

drift.spec: This spec: the mask glyph, the reveal, the sealed state with Replace and Cancel, setAt.
drift.today: As of 64f4b19, parts/text-field's masked option draws each character as the bullet glyph; there is no reveal, no sealed state, no Replace or Cancel, and no set note.
